name: Death Quips
description: Shows a short remark every time you die, matched to how far you got.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Show a quip when you die.

show-stats.name: Show attempt and percent
show-stats.description: Add a small second line with the attempt number and the percent you died at.

practice-mode.name: Show in practice mode
practice-mode.description: Also show quips for deaths in practice mode.

min-percent.name: Minimum percent
min-percent.description: Only show a quip when you die at or past this percent. Ignored in platformer levels.

duration.name: Time on screen
duration.description: How many seconds a quip stays visible before fading out.

custom-quips.name: Custom quips
custom-quips.description: Your own lines, separated by <cy>|</c>. Use <cg>{percent}</c> and <cg>{attempt}</c> to insert the current values, for example: <cy>Attempt {attempt} was a mistake | {percent}% is a number, I guess</c>

only-custom.name: Only use custom quips
only-custom.description: Use only your own lines instead of mixing them with the built-in ones. Has no effect while the custom list is empty.
